{{Short description|Georgian biologist and academic (born 1952)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=October 2025}}
'''Tinatin Sadunishvili''' ({{lang-ka|თინათინ სადუნიშვილი}}; born 22 December 1952) is a Georgian biologist and academic. A member of the [[Georgian National Academy of Sciences]] since 2015, her research focuses on plant biochemistry.

==Career==
Sadunishvili was born on 22 December 1952 in [[Tbilisi]], [[Georgian Soviet Socialist Republic]].<ref name="npl">{{cite web |title=თინათინ სადუნიშვილი |url=http://www.nplg.gov.ge/bios/en/00006158/ |website=[[National Library of Georgia]] |access-date=13 October 2025 |archive-date=8 July 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240708210541/http://www.nplg.gov.ge/bios/en/00006158/ |url-status=live }}</ref> She got a degree in biology in 1975 from the [[Tbilisi State University]] and got a doctor of science in biology from the Institute of Plant Biochemistry of the National Academy of Sciences of Georgia in 1995 with a thesis on studies on structure, kinetics and regulation of nitrogen metabolism enzyme and ammonia assmimilation pathways in plants.<ref name="academy">{{cite web |title=Sadunishvili Tinatin |url=http://science.org.ge/?team=tinatin-sadunishvili&lang=en |website=[[Georgian National Academy of Sciences]] |access-date=13 October 2025 |archive-date=17 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211017154539/http://science.org.ge/?team=tinatin-sadunishvili&lang=en |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="stem">{{cite web |title=Tinatin Sadunishvili |url=https://stemwomen.asia/profile/tinatin-sadunishvili |website=stemwomen.asia |access-date=13 October 2025}}</ref>

Between 1994 and 2004, Sadunishvili worked as professor of the [[Georgian Technical University]].<ref name="academy" /><ref name="npl" /><ref name="stem" /><ref name="twas" /> She has worked as head of Laboratory at Durmishidze Institute of Biochemistry and Biotechnology of the Sergi Durmishidze Institute of Biochemistry and Biotechnology of the [[Agricultural University of Georgia]] since 2005 and since 2013 she is full professor and head of department of plant biochemistry and biotechnolgy.<ref name="academy" /><ref name="npl" /><ref name="stem" /><ref name="twas" />

In 2009 Sadunishvili was appointed corresponding member of the [[Georgian National Academy of Sciences]] and in 2015 full member.<ref name="academy" /><ref name="twas" /> In 2022 she was elected member of the [[The World Academy of Sciences]] directory.<ref name="twas">{{cite web |title=Sadunishvili Tinatin |url=https://twas.org/directory/sadunishvili-tinatin |website=[[The World Academy of Sciences]] |access-date=13 October 2025}}</ref>

She has been invited professor and researcher at foreign universities such as [[Eötvös Loránd University]] (Hungary), [[University of Murcia]], (Spain), [[Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory]], (USA) and [[Meisei University]] (Japan).<ref name="academy" /><ref name="stem" />

Sadunishvili is also member of the European Plant Science Organization and has worked on mentoring young scientists, especially women.<ref name="stem" /> She is also member of the editorial boards of scientifics journals such as ''Agrarian Science, Microbiology and Biotechnology'' and the ''Bulletin of the Georgian National Academy of Sciences''.<ref name="stem" />

==Books==
*''Plants for a Healthy Environment'' (co-author), Batumi, Sak. Sci. Acad. Biochem. and Biotech. In-T, 2005, p. 232<ref name="academy" />
